run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to compute adsorption energy for an adsorbate plus surface atoms object
compute_hybrid_adsorption_energy: compute the hybrid adsorption energy using DFT slab energies and ML-relaxed adslab energies
compute_full_adsorption_energy: compute the full adsorption energy using ML-relaxed slabs by setting relax_surface to true
relax_adslab_system: relax an adslab system with a given calculator and optimizer and return the relaxed energy
save_relaxed_atoms_json: save relaxed adslab and slab atoms as JSON-encoded strings in the results dictionary
